data.name: Bushan
data.gender_notes: Bushan is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Bushan is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘bhu-shan’, meaning ‘sturdy’, ‘strong’ or ‘established’. In Hindu mythology, Bushan is an epithet of Lord Vishnu, who is the preserver of the universe. The name Bushan carries the meaning “Strong, Sturdy” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Bushan usually hope their child will grow to embody strong, sturdy and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Bushan belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Strong, Sturdy.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Bushan total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
